notes.title: Alpha 0.2a
notes.content:
Hello Mechanization Community,

Alpha 0.2a brings the Halloween update to Mechanization which includes:

 Pumpkin (Ore) - Sells for $6
 Pumpkin Dropper - Costs $4000, 30 RP to research and drops 2 pumpkins every 2 seconds
 A Halloween themed main menu
 Small bug fixes

This event will run until November 3rd 2023. Once it ends, any event droppers in your factories will stay however they can't be placed again.

notes.title: Less than 24 hours to go
notes.content:
There is less than 24 hours until Mechanization releases to early access!

Questions
Q: How much will the game cost?
A: $9.00 US

Q: What time tomorrow does the game release?
A: 6PM BST | 1PM ET

Q: Where can I get the game for free?
A: We are going to be running giveaways in our Discord throughout the week of release.

Q: What will come in the first EA update and when?
A: The first EA update will add rebirthing; there is no ETA on when that update will be released.

Be sure to join our Discord  for giveaways, bug reporting, suggestions & more!

notes.title: MECHANIZATION - EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2564440/extras/mechanization-full-banner.png?t=1693821797

Mechanization is being released to early access on October 5th 2023.

What will the early access version contain?
On EA release, you can expect the following features:

 Droppers, Smelters, Conveyors, etc
 Electricity
 Progression System (Tech Tree)
 Airdrop System
 Decoration Objects
 Cloud Saves


What features will be added throughout early access?
I plan to add the following features during early access:

 More bug fixes & optimizations
 More items, droppers, machines, resources & progression balances
 Rebirth system and rarer items
 PvE events (AI) and factory defenses
 Lua modding API
 Multiplayer
